newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Meralco says 8-mth sales up 10.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Meralco says 8-mth sales up 10.8 pct.

text.p: Philippine electricity distributor Manila Electric Co said on Thursday its sales for the first eight months of the year rose by 10.8 percent year-on-year to 11.593 billion kilowatt-hours (kwh).
Sales during the eight-month period to residential, commercial and industrial customers grew by 10.1 percent, 10.3 percent and 12.1 percent, respectively, the company said in a statement.
With the latest sales figures, Meralco will likely exceed its projected increase of 8 to 10 percent in electricity sales for all of 1996, a Meralco official said.

"We are on the upper end of our forecast so that 10 percent looks achievable especially with the performance of the first eight months. The increased economic activity will make the double digit sales rise attainable," Meralco senior vice-president Benito de la Cruz told Reuters.
De la Cruz said Meralco had targeted an 8 to 10 percent increase in sales this year over last year's 15.876 billion kilowatt-hours.
